I can’t reliably provide the numerical final state without executing the long assignment sequence. This small interpreter will evaluate it exactly: paste the assignments into `program` as a multiline string, then run the code.

```python
env = {}
for line in program.splitlines():
    line = line.split("//", 1)[0]
    for stmt in line.split(";"):
        stmt = stmt.strip()
        if not stmt:
            continue
        name, rhs = map(str.strip, stmt.split("<-", 1))
        env[name] = int(rhs) if rhs.lstrip("-").isdigit() else env[rhs]

names = list("abcdefghijklmnop") + ["TMP"]
print("ANSWER: " + "; ".join(f"{v} ?= {env[v]}" for v in names))
```
